label: Bible Study
prompt: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also _____.
verse: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
note: The law of the harvest — the seed and the crop always match.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not _____ thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verse: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
note: Spoken to Joshua before the Jordan: God goes BEFORE thee — He's already up ahead.

label: Sunday School
prompt: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a _____ upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother's womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man.
verse: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother's womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man.
note: Samson finally tells Delilah the secret: no razor, ever — and you can guess what she went shopping for.

label: Deep Water
prompt: _____ all things; hold fast that which is good.
verse: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
note: 'Prove' means test, like assaying metal — examine everything, pocket only the good.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter _____, but the spirit giveth life.
verse: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
note: 'The letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life' — the most quoted hermeneutics lecture in history.
